calculation.description: Ranks assets by acceleration of medium-term relative returns, scaled by trailing 30-day downside volatility. Higher values indicate improving medium-horizon trend per unit of downside risk. Signal is lagged one completed session before forward-return evaluation.

validation.regime_notes: 20-day signal passes the benchmark gates (absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840). Recent 2031-2033 10-day IC was strongly positive (0.076586), while 2028-2030 was near zero (0.003760); interpret small-universe estimates conservatively. The 10-day horizon failed ICIR, so admission uses the explicitly validated 20-day horizon.
validation.provenance: Spearman cross-sectional IC over 15 tradable benchmark assets; dates with at least 8 valid instruments; signal uses only data available through the decision date.
